notes: Corrected the unto of unto all the brethren: it now rides with τοῖς as a discontinuous unto … the headed on the, and πᾶσι keeps a bare all. Rule 21 makes the English determiner the anchor of a case-preposition unit, rule 96 restates that another word takes the case preposition only where no article stands to anchor it, and rule 42's nigh unto the place is the same shape.
Everything else stands as accepted: μέν unrepresented under rule 70, the preverb particles inside their verbs' units under rule 106, and τε → both with καί → and under rule 70's two-conjunction arm.
